title: S-19r vb-benchmark-cleanup: Replace 11 STUB: markers in benchmark_tests.rs with real assertions; convert aggregate_resource_budget.rs to real Criterion bench
description: Chore S-19r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-wmq9z). Black-hat review round 1 found: (1) the original bead cited 12 STUB: markers but the actual count in crates/vb_benchmark/tests/benchmark_tests.rs is 11; (2) the exact string `// STUB: This test will FAIL` appears 0 times — the actual text is `// STUB: <function_name> <description>`. Real source: crates/vb_benchmark/tests/benchmark_tests.rs lines 10, 20, 31, 41, 51, 58, 68, 79, 90, 107, 127 (11 STUB: markers, each naming a function that always returns the wrong value: `baseline_within_budget`, `budget_utilization_percent`, `latency_within_budget`, `result_exceeds_threshold`, `check_evidence_gate`). The grep test in the original bead was wrong. Real source for the second part: crates/vb_benchmark/src/aggregate_resource_budget.rs is a placeholder (not a real Criterion bench — it's a stub that returns a hardcoded number). The fix: (1) replace each STUB: function body with the correct implementation (e.g., `baseline_within_budget` should compare the actual baseline to the budget, not always return false); (2) convert aggregate_resource_budget.rs to a real Criterion bench that aggregates the resource budget across 10-100 runs; (3) the regression-shield test asserts STUB: count is 0 in production code (not the wrong text from the original bead).
